name: UNICEF Egypt
description: UNICEF works in Egypt to protect children's rights and ensure access to quality education and development opportunities for all children and young people.

name: British Council Egypt
description: The British Council builds connections and opportunities through arts, culture, education, and English language programs across Egypt and the Arab world.

name: INJAZ Egypt
description: INJAZ Egypt is a youth development NGO that inspires and prepares young Egyptians to succeed in a global economy through entrepreneurship and work-readiness education.

name: Mercy Corps Yemen
description: Mercy Corps works in Yemen to provide life-saving assistance and build foundations for sustainable peace and development, with strong programming for Yemeni youth.

name: UNDP Egypt
description: UNDP Egypt partners with government and civil society to advance sustainable development, youth empowerment, and gender equality across Egypt.

name: Sharek Youth Forum
description: Sharek (Arabic for 'participate') is a regional youth network supporting young people across the Arab world in advocacy, civic participation, and community leadership initiatives.
